title: CORRUPTED ENTITIES
description: A Post-Apocalyptic(ish) ARG mod with lore, corruption, and exploration.
body:
![The Corrupted Entities Logo ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a1f0950d8697b32e3341a98563fa4e562e136b3a.png)

**We all know the missing texture block, but do you know a mod that milks the thing entirely?**

Introducing... **[TITLE CARD]**

But no seriously, this is _**Corrupted Entities,**_ an ARG mod with terribly written lore, cursed animations, mobs, and much more!

This mod was made possible using MCreator, please check it out if you can!

It's recommended to use this mod with this resource pack over on curseforge. (https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/glitch-resourse-pack) by Aloaqplay. shoutout to him!

**_NOTE 1: THIS MOD IS STILL IN THE WIP (work in progress) STAGE! THERE MAY BE IMPERFECTIONS AND BUGS!
NOTE 2: THIS MOD'S LOADER AND VERSION REQUIREMENTS ARE VERY STRICT! EXPECT TO DOWNLOAD DIFFERENT VERSIONS OF MINECRAFT!_**
